annotations.title: Watch a phone number for changes

description: Start a watch on a toll free or local phone number for a person who wants an email when it changes, like a number they want that someone has today. Use it when the person asks to be told about a number and gives their email address. VanityNumbers.com emails them a link to confirm, and nothing starts until they click it. Then they get what we have on it now. A toll free number is watched with the same 7 digits in all 7 toll free area codes, a local number with every version of it in its state and a check each month of whether it's still in use. After that they get an email on the 15th when it or a related number has changed, and every three months that it's still being watched. Returns whether the confirm email went out. It can't buy or reserve a number.

email.description: The person's email address. The confirm email and the watch emails go there.
email.title: Email

name.description: Optional: the person's first name, for the emails.
name.title: Name

number.description: The number to watch, by digits or spelling, like 844-758-6237, 844-PLUMBER or 512-758-6237.
number.title: Number
